summary: self-learn-qa skill DONE (commit 8035267, main; skills/self-learn-qa/SKILL.md, no daemon changes). Flow: read watermark from the CURRENT "Nightly QA run record" note (search_knowledge → get_task_detail; first run = 24h) → graph_delta(since) (empty ⇒ minimal record + stop) → map delta tasks to repos via get_task_detail (repo + test_cmd in one call; no test_cmd ⇒ skip & report, never guess) → run each suite, diff vs last night's recorded failures → NEW failures must reproduce on ONE rerun (flakes logged only) → file ≤5 problem nodes/night (TaskCreate + set_task_repo + suggest_links + context edges to suspect delta tasks) → revise per-repo "Test plan — <repo>" note via supersede chain only on real observations → write tonight's run record (supersedes last night's; watermark = delta.now) → ONE consolidated request_guidance proposing fixes, stop. Persistence decision: watermark + failure diff live in the superseded-nightly run-record note, NOT a config key — POST /config whitelists fields with no read-back path, and the diff needs a persisted run record anyway (zero daemon surface added). Hard rules encoded: ADD-only (planner-runaway standing rule), no fixing/merging at night, no branch_task, bounded output/budget. Verified: every referenced tool/endpoint linted against lib/mcp-core.js + daemon.js, and a full two-night dry-run walkthrough on an isolated :8798 daemon (temp HOME, seeded native task + failing repo) exercised every documented call as written — delta, repo/test_cmd lookup, rerun gate, problem filing + edges, run-record supersede chain (search returns only current), test-plan revision, guidance, empty-delta and 400 paths. Live :8787 untouched; only my file committed (a concurrently-staged test/smoke.sh sweep was caught and rewritten out via pathspec commit; other worker's staged edits preserved).
